findings.summary: Intake tool policy forbids canonical artifact writes, but Intake responsibilities/deliverables require creating canonical run_manifest/event_log/workspace_index (audit spine).

evidence.note: Intake restriction says artifact_write is allow_noncanonical_only.
evidence.quote: allow_noncanonical_only

evidence.note: O2 Intake & DAG Work Planner initializes run_manifest/event_log/workspace_index.
evidence.quote: Validate plan_package_final.json, repo_context.json, workspace_context.json and initialize run_manifest/event_log/workspace_index.

evidence.note: Phase 1 deliverable explicitly includes audit spine artifacts.
evidence.quote: Audit spine: immutable run_manifest, append-only event_log, versioned artifact store with stage-boundary checkpoints.

findings.summary: Review stage tool policy denies artifact_write/workspace_write, but reviewer components are required to emit findings artifacts (review_findings.json / integration review_findings.json).

evidence.note: Review stage restriction blocks any artifact output.
evidence.quote: deny

evidence.note: Review stage restriction blocks any workspace output.
evidence.quote: deny

evidence.note: Per-lane reviewer must produce review_findings.json.
evidence.quote: Produce per-lane review_findings.json with RFC 6901 evidence pointers; flag cross-lane dependency issues.

evidence.note: Integration reviewer must also produce an artifacts-based findings output.
evidence.quote: Produce integration review_findings.json with RFC 6901 evidence pointers; findings-only (CNS12).

findings.summary: Milestone M1 claims AT4 passes with a stage sequence that omits required Judge→Freeze and adds Patch; this conflicts with AT4’s own pass criteria and with R4’s minimum stage set.

evidence.note: M1 exit criterion asserts an AT4 pass using a different stage sequence.
evidence.quote: AT4 passes (single-lane subset): stage sequence Intake→Generate→Validate→Review→Patch recorded with checkpoint at each transition.

evidence.note: AT4 requires the minimal sequence to include Judge and Freeze (and does not mention Patch).
evidence.quote: Stage sequence includes at minimum Intake → Generate → Validate → Review → Judge → Freeze and a checkpoint boundary is recorded at every stage transition.

evidence.note: R4 defines the minimum required stage set (no Patch stage mentioned).
evidence.quote: ...with at minimum the stages: Intake → Generate → Validate → Review → Judge → Freeze...

findings.summary: Stage taxonomy is inconsistent across requirements, architecture, milestones, and tool policy (e.g., WorkPlanning vs Plan, Patch vs PatchApply, IntegrateAndValidate vs Integration), creating ambiguity for validators expecting stage_handoff coverage “at every stage transition.”

evidence.note: R4 lists a minimum stage set.
evidence.quote: Intake → Generate → Validate → Review → Judge → Freeze

evidence.note: Tool policy uses a different stage set including WorkPlanning, PatchApply, IntegrateAndValidate.
O1 linear state machine uses Plan and Patch stages not named in R4/tool policy.
evidence.quote: Enforce strict stage ordering and closure gates (Intake → Plan → Generate → Validate → Review → Patch → Judge → Freeze).

evidence.note: M1 deliverable uses stage names including PatchApply distinct from architecture’s “Patch”.
evidence.quote: Tool permission matrix enforcement for Intake, WorkPlanning, Generate, PatchApply, Validate, and Review stages.

findings.summary: R10 defines evidence pointers as objects with structure {artifact_ref, entity_id|null, json_pointer, note}, but the plan’s own evidence_pointers instances include additional fields (candidate_id, artifact_id, quote), contradicting the claimed single required structure.

evidence.note: R10 specifies a fixed evidence pointer structure.
evidence.quote: ...RFC 6901 JSON Pointer objects with the structure {artifact_ref, entity_id|null, json_pointer, note}...

evidence.note: Example evidence pointer includes candidate_id, artifact_id, and quote fields beyond R10’s stated structure.
Glossary also defines evidence pointer as {artifact_ref, entity_id|null, json_pointer, note} (no candidate_id/artifact_id).
evidence.quote: An RFC 6901 JSON Pointer object {artifact_ref, entity_id|null, json_pointer, note} referencing a versioned JSON artifact location; used as the sole standard for traceability across decisions, findings

findings.summary: Milestone M2 exit criteria reference AT12, AT13, AT14, AT22, but M2 deliverables do not include Judge Pod (C23) required for AT22 writer/reviewer/judge separation validation. Judge Pod is not delivered until M4.

evidence.note: M2 exit criteria includes AT22 which requires Judge Pod.
evidence.quote: AT22 passes: writer/reviewer/judge roles distinct per lane; reviewers emit findings-only; multi-vendor routing recorded.

evidence.note: M2 deliverables do not include Judge Pod.
Judge Pod (C23) is delivered in M4, not M2.
evidence.quote: Judge Pod (C23) evaluating integrated outputs

findings.summary: Requirement R22 mandates multi-vendor diversity across writer/reviewer/judge roles, but architecture O2 components C14-C17 (per-lane Writer/Validator/Reviewer/Patcher) do not explicitly specify multi-vendor routing enforcement at the lane level, only at global orchestrator level (C11).

evidence.note: R22 requires multi-vendor diversity enforced by orchestrator routing.
evidence.quote: orchestrator routing SHALL enforce default multi-vendor separation across writer/reviewer/judge roles

evidence.note: C11 Global Orchestrator owns multi-vendor role separation but per-lane components do not restate this.
evidence.quote: Enforce multi-vendor role separation across writers/reviewers/judges (CNS12).

evidence.note: C14 Writer Pool does not specify multi-vendor enforcement.

findings.summary: Acceptance test AT4 pass criteria states 'Stage sequence includes at minimum Intake → Generate → Validate → Review → Judge → Freeze' but O2 architecture includes an Integration stage between parallel lanes and Judge that is not listed in AT4's expected sequence.

evidence.note: AT4 expected sequence does not include Integration stage.
evidence.quote: Stage sequence includes at minimum Intake → Generate → Validate → Review → Judge → Freeze

evidence.note: C11 Global Orchestrator owns DAG workflow including Integration stage.
evidence.quote: Own top-level DAG workflow: Intake → Parallel Lanes → Integration → Judge → Freeze.

findings.summary: Decision DEC5 allocates AT10 (evidence pointer validation) to Phase 3, but AT10 maps to requirement R10 which is a MUST requirement applicable to all stages. Evidence pointer validation should be enforced starting in Phase 1 where canonical artifacts are first emitted.

evidence.note: DEC5 allocates AT10 to Phase 3.
evidence.quote: Phase 3: AT15, AT10, AT16 plus integration-specific merge ordering criterion.

evidence.note: AT10 maps to R10, a MUST requirement for all evidence pointers.
R10 is a MUST requirement applicable to all canonical artifacts from the start.
evidence.quote: All evidence pointers, traceability links, findings references, and decision citations in canonical artifacts SHALL use a single standard

findings.summary: Milestone M1 deliverable M1-D4 describes 'Single-lane execution path: one Writer (C14), one Validator (C15), one Reviewer (C16), one Patcher (C17)' but these component IDs correspond to O2 multi-lane components, not O1 sequential components. M1 is intended to prove O1-equivalent sequential path but references O2 component IDs.

evidence.note: M1-D4 references C14-C17 which are defined as multi-lane components in O2.
evidence.quote: Single-lane execution path: one Writer (C14), one Validator (C15), one Reviewer (C16), one Patcher (C17) operating sequentially

evidence.note: C14 is defined as 'Writer Pool (Multi-Lane)' not single-lane.
evidence.quote: Writer Pool (Multi-Lane)

findings.summary: Requirement R7 mandates workspace_index.json, context_packs/, and stage_handoffs/ directories in the freeze bundle, but acceptance test AT7 pass criteria lists these as individual artifacts (workspace_index.json) and directories (context_packs/, stage_handoffs/) without clarifying that context_packs/ and stage_handoffs/ must contain per-stage/per-lane artifacts as implied by the architecture.

evidence.note: R7 specifies directories context_packs/ and stage_handoffs/ as part of freeze bundle.
evidence.quote: workspace_index.json, context_packs/, and stage_handoffs/

evidence.note: AT7 lists directories but does not specify required contents or structure.
evidence.quote: Freeze bundle contains all minimum artifacts: implementation_run_manifest.json, implementation_event_log.jsonl, work_plan.json, patchsets (diff-embedded JSON), repo_snapshot.json, test_results.json

findings.summary: Risk K12 mitigation states 'deterministic apply/merge ordering rules independent of wall-clock completion timing' but does not specify how this ordering is recorded/audited in the event_log or integration_report to enable reproducibility verification.

evidence.note: K12 mitigation describes deterministic ordering but not audit/recording mechanism.
evidence.quote: deterministic apply/merge ordering rules independent of wall-clock completion timing

evidence.note: C18 responsibilities mention 'integrated patchset ordering record' but not event_log recording.
evidence.quote: Produce merged repo_snapshot.json and integrated patchset ordering record.

findings.summary: Glossary defines 'Context Pack' as 'bounded, deterministically-compiled set of workspace artifacts' but does not clarify whether context packs are themselves versioned artifacts with artifact_refs or are ephemeral compilations referenced only via workspace_index.json.

evidence.note: Context Pack glossary definition does not specify versioning/artifact_ref status.
evidence.quote: A bounded, deterministically-compiled set of workspace artifacts provided to a role at a stage, selected by explicit rules and cited via evidence pointers.

evidence.note: R17 requires context packs cited via evidence pointers but does not clarify if packs themselves have artifact_refs.
evidence.quote: orchestrator SHALL build bounded context packs deterministically for each stage/role invocation using explicit selection rules, with context pack contents cited via evidence pointers
